cards.title: Páginas escultóricas que representan modelos de lenguaje
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés. Sculptural curled sheets of handmade paper arranged in a gentle wave, delicate light and shadow implying the structure of language, neutral parchment background, violet refractions, contemporary art direction, tactile, understated.
